ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio; approximately 4% of pixels are high-intensity white/grey highlights against a 96% low-intensity dark charcoal background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast annular and linear shapes across the ventral field; specific high-intensity cluster localized at the posterior-lateral tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth of 12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged topography; pixel amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels occurring at irregular intervals along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapering distal tips; the overall shape displays an upward vertical sweep relative to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white circular and elliptical rings (annuli) distributed bilaterally; dense spatial clustering observed in the medial and lower sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel streaks; prominent diagonal abrasion on the right lobe and several parallel horizontal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible brown-grey irregular textured clusters of sessile organisms (barnacles) attached to the extreme distal edges of both fluke lobes.
